sources.scope: 191 valid, distinct Frankfurt municipal cadastral polygons verified in thirteen local 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP settlement locator. The service-advertised GEOJSON response preserves native EPSG:25832 boundaries, transformed with an explicit ETRS89 projection. FSK is native cadastral identity; OBJECTID/GmlID remain transport identity. Stable hit counts before and after all pages, strict default OBJECTID order, forced three-row pagination, all 191 fresh native FSK reads through FES equality, valid synthetic absence, footprint and source binding passed. Independent GEOS in EPSG:32632 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Unsupported application/json and sorting requests, and the different POST serializer, remain documented; the executable profile uses only supported GET operations. Wider municipal completeness, legal boundary accuracy and long-term identifier continuity remain unverified.
